items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Did you ever know him? Yeah, I was Spud Murphy at the dance hall at the casino.

ctx.x: He just dropped out of there. He used to come sit in at the famous door.
He used to come at the famous door and sit in, yeah. Oh, what about Spud Murphy? Did you ever know him? Yeah, I was Spud Murphy at the dance hall at the casino.
